[1/2] Enemies cycle: close the brute 2.5-3.0 m dead zone so it advances into attack range, with a stall test, idle pair and brute drill

impact_assessment.why: A brute moves only when farther than 3.0 m but slams only within 2.5 m; at 2.7 m from a stationary player it stands still forever.
impact_assessment.benefits: Brutes close the final half metre and slam, matching their intended melee pressure without changing damage, range or cooldowns.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: brute movement branch only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic movement, no new damage tuning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first stall test, a fixed-time idle capture pair, a brute-gap drill and the fairness/campaign suites.

[1/2] Levels cycle: add a base perimeter to the platform rim mesh, keeping one node/draw, with an approach pair and platform-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The platform's dark side merges into the floor; the top rim marks the landing edge but the 0.7 m base height is unreadable from the approach.
impact_assessment.benefits: A lit base line frames the jumpable step from the floor, completing the platform's readable silhouette without a new node or shadow draw.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: decoration mesh only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no collider, sim, camera or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first base-strip test, an approach capture pair at 960x540, platform-drill hash parity and the frame-budget gate.

[1/2] UI cycle: tag and color critical kills in the persistent kill feed, with a forced-critical pair and campaign critical-count parity

impact_assessment.why: The kill feed keeps kills for 2.5 s but critical kills look identical to normal ones; only the transient CRITICAL caption and larger total hint at the reward.
impact_assessment.benefits: A CRIT prefix and accent color make the critical record readable after the caption fades, without changing kill scoring or the feed lifetime.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD feed entry only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, reward, kill or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first forced-critical feed tests, a reused critical capture pair, a kited critical-count run and the full gates.

[1/2] Graphics cycle: tint the viewmodel with per-weapon overdrive materials while the timer runs, with a staged pair and overdrive drill

impact_assessment.why: Overdrive is a prominent 8 s x2 state, but only the HUD line changes; the held weapon looks identical, so the active power-up lacks a visual state.
impact_assessment.benefits: The gun glows with a brighter per-weapon overdrive material while the timer runs and reverts automatically, using existing nodes and no new draws.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: material selection only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, timer, damage or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first material-state tests, a staged overdrive pair at 960x540, an overdrive drill hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Audio cycle: map the clutch wave-clear event to a distinct voice and CLUTCH CLEAR caption, with a low-HP pair, WAV and clutch drill

impact_assessment.why: The sim emits clutch on a wave clear at 30 HP or less, but the game ignores it; only the generic wave cue plays, so a notable survival moment is unannounced.
impact_assessment.benefits: A distinct chime and CLUTCH CLEAR caption mark the low-health clear while the wave completion voice still plays.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, score, HP or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first clutch/normal-clear tests, a low-HP caption pair, a clutch drill and a WAV/spectrogram probe.

[1/2] Progression cycle: clear the debrief save warning after a later successful profile write, keeping the lifetime error counter, with a retry pair and save_retry drill

impact_assessment.why: profile_save_errors is a lifetime counter; one transient locked save leaves PROFILE NOT SAVED on every later debrief even after a successful save, falsely implying current progress is unsaved.
impact_assessment.benefits: A separate last-outcome flag makes the warning truthful while preserving the error count for telemetry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save status + debrief draw; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile schema, atomic writes and error counter unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first failed-then-success test, a retry capture pair at 960x540, a save_retry drill and the full gates.
